talosbo - s1 pro cordless robotic pool c.name: Talosbo - S1 Pro Cordless Robotic Pool Cleaner For Flat Above-Ground Pools,Automatic Pool Vacuum,120 Min Runtime - Black
talosbo - s1 pro cordless robotic pool c.description: The Talosbo S1 Pro Cordless Robotic Pool Cleaner delivers powerful and effortless pool maintenance for small and flat pools. Equipped with dual high-performance motors and an optimized flow design, it provides strong suction to capture dirt, leaves, and debris for crystal-clear water. Its true cordless design eliminates tangled hoses and complex setup—simply press a button to start cleaning. Weighing just 6.3 lb, it’s easy to lift and drains in just 15 seconds for quick, mess-free handling. A high-capacity 2.2L filter basket collects more debris to reduce maintenance frequency and extend product life. Powered by a 4500 mAh lithium battery, the Pleco S1 Pro runs up to 120 minutes per charge and recharges fully in just 2.5 hours. When the battery runs low, the cleaner automatically stops near the pool wall for effortless retrieval with the included hook. Ideal for flat above-ground and in-ground pools up to 1076 sq. ft., the Pleco S1 Pro keeps your pool sparkling clean with minimal effort.
